units.title: Entrepreneurial Mindset, Creativity and Innovation
units.topics: Concept of entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial traits, creativity and lateral thinking, design thinking process, empathetic inquiry, problem definition, ideation techniques.

units.title: Opportunity Identification and Business Modelling
units.topics: Market research and feasibility analysis, Business Model Canvas (BMC), value proposition, customer segments, cost structure and revenue streams, intellectual property basics.

units.title: Introduction to Value Education
units.topics: Need, basic guidelines, content and process for value education, self-exploration, continuous happiness and prosperity, basic human aspirations.

units.title: Harmony in the Human Being
units.topics: Human being as co-existence of Self and Body, needs of Self and Body, harmony of Self with Body, Sanyam and Swasthya.

units.title: Harmony in the Family and Society
units.topics: Values in relationships: trust (Vishwas), respect (Samman), affection, care, guidance, reverence, glory, gratitude, and love. Comprehensive human goal.

units.title: Harmony in the Nature (Existence)
units.topics: Four orders in nature, interconnectedness, mutual fulfillment, recyclability and self-regulation in nature, existence as co-existence.

units.title: Introduction to Industrial Robotics
units.topics: Historical development, robot anatomy, work volume, robot drive systems, control systems and dynamic performance, precision of movement, end effectors, sensors in robotics.

units.title: End Effectors
units.topics: Types of end effectors, mechanical grippers, magnetic grippers, vacuum grippers, adhesive grippers, gripper force analysis, tools as end effectors, considerations in gripper selection and design.

units.title: Mathematical Modeling of a robot
units.topics: Spatial descriptions, homogeneous transformations, Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) representation, forward and inverse kinematics of serial manipulators, Jacobian, singularities.

units.title: Fundamentals of Robot Programming and Applications
units.topics: Lead-through programming, teach pendant, textual robot programming languages, motions commands, robot safety standards, material handling, machine loading/unloading, welding, spray painting.

units.title: Advanced Robot Programming Techniques
units.topics: Offline programming, simulation of robotic cells, integration of vision systems with robot controllers, trajectory planning, collision avoidance, collaborative robots (Cobots).

units.title: Fundamentals of Mechanism
units.topics: Kinematic link, pair, chain, mechanism, machine, degrees of freedom, Kutzbach and Grubler's criteria, inversions of four-bar chain, single and double slider-crank chains.

units.title: Mechanisms in Automation Systems
units.topics: Straight line motion mechanisms, steering gear mechanisms, indexing mechanisms, Geneva mechanism, ratchet and pawl, intermittent motion mechanisms used in automated assembly.

units.title: Kinematic Analysis of Mechanisms: Analytical Method
units.topics: Loop closure equations for four-bar and slider crank mechanisms, displacement, velocity and acceleration analysis using complex algebra and vector methods.

units.title: Kinematic Analysis of Mechanisms: Graphical Method
units.topics: Relative velocity method, instantaneous centre of velocity, Kennedy's theorem, relative acceleration method, Coriolis acceleration component and its applications.

units.title: Synthesis of Mechanisms
units.topics: Type, number, and dimensional synthesis, function generation, path generation, Freudenstein's equation, two-position and three-position synthesis using graphical and analytical methods.

units.title: DC Motors
units.topics: Principles of operation, torque-speed characteristics of shunt, series, and compound DC motors, starting, braking, and speed control methods (armature and field control).

units.title: Induction Motors
units.topics: Three-phase induction motors, rotating magnetic field, torque-slip characteristics, starting and braking, speed control using VFD (Variable Frequency Drives), V/f control.

units.title: Synchronous Machines and Special purpose motors
units.topics: Synchronous motors, permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM), stepper motors (types, micro-stepping), brushless DC (BLDC) motors, servo motors for robotic joints.

units.title: Fundamentals of Electric Drives
units.topics: Components of electric drives, choice of electric motors, multi-quadrant operation of drives, closed loop control of drives, torque and speed control loops.

units.title: Application of Electric Drives
units.topics: Selection of motor rating for continuous, intermittent, and short-time duty, industrial drive applications in robotics, CNC machine tools, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), packaging systems.

units.title: Introduction to AIML and Feature Extraction and Selection
units.topics: Overview of AI and ML, supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, data preprocessing, normalization, feature extraction and dimensionality reduction (PCA).

units.title: ML Algorithms: Classification & Regression
units.topics: Linear and polynomial regression, logistic regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), Naive Bayes.

units.title: Feature Engineering, Development of ML Model & Evaluation
units.topics: Model training, validation, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation metrics: confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, bias-variance tradeoff.

units.title: Reinforced and Deep Learning
units.topics: Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), perceptron, backpropagation algorithm, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) basics, Reinforcement Learning concepts: agent, environment, reward, Q-learning.

units.title: Conversational Skills and Role-Playing
units.topics: Role-playing everyday scenarios, dialogue delivery, conversational Marathi and social cues.

units.title: Reading, Summarizing and Creative Expression
units.topics: Newspaper reading and analysis, creative writing, blogs and social media posts up to 200 words.

units.title: Introduction to Business Economics and Finance
units.topics: Basic economic concepts, law of demand and supply, elasticity of demand, time value of money, cash flow diagrams, present worth, future worth.

units.title: Cost Accounting
units.topics: Elements of cost, direct and indirect costs, cost classification, overhead allocation, preparation of cost sheet, break-even analysis.

units.title: Financial Accounting
units.topics: Double entry bookkeeping, journal, ledger, trial balance, preparation of Profit and Loss account and Balance Sheet.

units.title: Budget and Budgetary Control
units.topics: Meaning and objectives of budget, types of budgets: sales, production, cash, master budget, zero-base budgeting.

units.title: National and International Business and Finance
units.topics: Sources of project finance, working capital management, foreign exchange basics, international trade and financial institutions.

units.title: Introduction to ESD
units.topics: Multidisciplinary nature of environmental studies, concept of sustainable development, sustainable development goals (SDGs).

units.title: Soil Conservation and Management
units.topics: Soil erosion causes and effects, soil conservation practices, land degradation and restoration.

units.title: Water Sources and Management
units.topics: Water resources, water pollution, rainwater harvesting, watershed management, wastewater treatment and recycling.

units.title: Sustainability and Sustainability Practices
units.topics: Ecological footprint, carbon footprint, circular economy, waste management (solid and hazardous), life cycle assessment.

units.title: Sustainable Habitat and Sustainable Energy
units.topics: Green buildings, renewable energy sources (solar, wind, biomass), energy conservation and auditing, environmental policy and legislation.
